title: Write an architecture decision record
summary: Write down an important design decision in one page - the problem, the options and why you chose one - so that people who join later understand it. A help for any team; not required.

resources.title: Decision record template
resources.description: A Markdown file with the five headings: context, options, decision, consequences, status.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The engineer or architect who made or proposes the decision.

actors.name: Your team
actors.description: The people who will live with the decision.

steps.title: Copy the template into your repository
instructions: Create docs/adr/ in your repository if it does not exist.
Copy the template to docs/adr/NNNN-short-title.md with the next number.

steps.title: Write the problem, the options and the decision
instructions: Describe the problem in three sentences a new colleague would understand.
List at least two options with their pros and cons.
Write the decision and what it makes harder later.

steps.title: Discuss it in a pull request
steps.description: The team comments on the pull request. Disagreement is fine; it goes into the record as a consequence.

steps.title: Mark the record as accepted
instructions: Change the status to 'Accepted' with today's date.
